note: Worlds are drawn per k; each arm runs the same world under its own dynamics seed. The exact arms are the core's individual runner with the probe's competition round executed through the same interpreter; the crowd is the exact-state histogram with count draws; the averaged crowd replaces each lineage's reserves at a site by their average after every round. Readings are taken after the last tick. Evaluations count interpreter applications: one per member in the exact arms, one per state in the crowd.
